# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **Backport platform fixes**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.5 backports WinUI and Apple platform fixes from the v4 line.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Platform

- **Apple library and app TFM alignment backported** — The 26.0 library TFMs and unversioned app TFMs from v4 have been backported so .NET 9 consumers on Apple platforms pick up the correct native assets. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))
- **WinUI Projection DLL resolved on .NET 9** — Fixes a missing WinUI Projection DLL that caused runtime failures for .NET 9 WinUI consumers. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))
